description: Apply the CMAT to existing contacts. Visit each contact in the specified range and override its contact model according to the CMAT. Note that the contact models are entirely reassigned to each contact; all information stored in the previous contact model is lost. Alternatively, one can modify select contact model parameters at existing contacts using the contact property or contact method commands. By default, only mechanical contacts are considered.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('contact cmat apply ...') - Python SDK does not provide direct CMAT API, must use command interface

6.0: Live 6.0 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>'); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself.
7.0: Live 7.0 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>'); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself.
9.0: Live 9.7 grammar: the optional process selector precedes the subcommand ('contact mechanical <sub>' / 'contact thermal <sub>' / 'contact fluid <sub>' - fluid is 9.x-new); it is not a keyword of the subcommand itself.

examples.description: Apply CMAT to all mechanical contacts in the model

examples.command: contact cmat apply range group 'glass' matches 2
examples.description: Apply CMAT to contacts in group 'glass' with matches count of 2

examples.command: contact cmat apply range contact type 'ball-ball'
examples.description: Apply CMAT to all ball-ball contacts

examples.command: contact cmat apply thermal range group 'heated'
examples.description: Apply CMAT to thermal contacts in 'heated' group

examples.command: contact cmat apply range model linear
examples.description: Reapply CMAT to all contacts currently using linear model
